description: Issue a fresh DNS TXT challenge for your currently authenticated agent identity. Needs commerce.order for OAuth. Supply an HTTPS contact URL on a domain you control, especially on the first OAuth connection. Omitting contact reuses the current contact. This replaces the previous challenge and clears its verification. Publish the returned txtValue at dnsName, then call kya_verify. Domain control does not establish buyer identity or grant spending authority. Do not publish secrets in DNS.

clientId.description: Required unless you authenticate with the Authorization header (Bearer <clientId>:<secret>, or an OAuth access token issued for this server). The clientId returned by register_agent.

contact.description: HTTPS URL on your own public domain. No IP address, credentials, custom port or URL fragment.

secret.description: Required unless you authenticate with the Authorization header (Bearer <clientId>:<secret>, or an OAuth access token issued for this server). The secret returned by register_agent.

name: kya_challenge
